stem: The headquarters of 'Indian Bureau of Mines' is at –
expl: The headquarters of the Indian Bureau of Mines is located at Nagpur. The Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), established in 1948, is a multi-disciplinary government organization under the Ministry of Mines, engaged in the promotion of conservation, scientific development of mineral resources and protection of the environment in mines. The primary mission of the Indian Bureau of Mines is to promote the systematic and scientific development of mineral resources of the country (both onshore and offshore), through regulatory inspections of the mines, approval of mining plans and environmental management plans to ensure minimal adverse impact on the environment.

stem: In India the Temperate Forest Research center is in which established in-
expl: Himalayan Forest Research Institute has been established at Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) under the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE). Himalayan forest Research Institute (HFRI), was established as High Level conifer Regeneration Research Centre during May, 1977 for carring out research on Problem associated with natural regeneration of Silver Fir and Spruce. Hence, it is clear that the Himalayan forest Research Institute ahs never been named the temperate forest Research centre.

stem: National Research Centre on Camel is located at:
expl: The National Research Centre on Camel is located at Bikaner in Rajasthan. Notably, ICAR- National Research Centre on Camel is a premier research centre of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, which is an autonomous organization under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, GOI. Considering the importance of camels in the socio-economic development of arid and semi-arid zones, the GOI established a Project Directorate on Camel at Bikaner (India) on 5th July, 1984 under aegis of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) which was upgraded to the National Research Centre on Camel (NRCC) on September, 20, 1995.

stem: In which city was the National Disaster Response Force Academy established in the year 2018?
expl: The National Disaster Response Force Academy was established in 2018 by merging the existing National Civil Defence College (NCDC) in Nagpur. It serves as a premier institute providing high level disaster management training to NDRF and SDRF battalions, civil defence volunteers and disaster response personnel from SAARC and neighboring countries. Thus, it is clear that the National Disaster Response Force Academy was established in Nagpur, Maharashtra.
